Appendix A

Part I

## TITLES AND WAGE SCALE ASSIGNMENTS

The following table shows current titles and wage scale assignments.

Titles and Wage Scale Table

<table border="1"><tr><td>(A)</td><td>(B)</td></tr><tr><td>Wage Scale</td><td>Title</td></tr><tr><td>16</td><td>Accounting Assistant</td></tr><tr><td>18</td><td>Accounting Specialist (1)</td></tr><tr><td>16</td><td>Billing Verification Assistant</td></tr><tr><td>32</td><td>Circuit Layout Assigner</td></tr><tr><td>18</td><td>Claims Specialist</td></tr><tr><td>18</td><td>Collections Representative</td></tr><tr><td>21</td><td>Communications Assistant</td></tr><tr><td>3, 19</td><td>Communications Sales Specialist</td></tr><tr><td>30</td><td>Communications Technician</td></tr><tr><td>14</td><td>Computer Attendant (2)</td></tr><tr><td>16</td><td>Customer Service Assistant</td></tr><tr><td>27</td><td>Customer Service Associate</td></tr><tr><td>32</td><td>Digital Technician</td></tr><tr><td>12</td><td>Dispatch Assistant</td></tr><tr><td>14</td><td>Drafting Assistant</td></tr><tr><td>32</td><td>Electronic Technician</td></tr><tr><td>16</td><td>Engineering Assistant (1)</td></tr></table>

1) These titles are normally filled through promotions from within the department in which the vacancy exists.

(2) These titles are normally filled through promotions from Wage Scale 10 in the department in which the vacancy exists.

(3) Employees who were in these titles effective August 8, 1998, will remain in these titles as long as they perform these duties. No employees will be placed in these titles subsequent to August 9, 1998.

(4) Employees in these titles effective August 9, 1986, will remain in these titles as long as they perform these duties. No employees will be placed in these titles subsequent to August 10, 1986.
